headline: The morning orders all filled: PASHUPATI exited, 6 add-ons and 8 entries bought; nothing is left to order on the swing side, and BSE is the one off-rule option position.

points.label: Process
points.text: This morning the plan was followed in full: the PASHUPATI exit (13 shares at Rs27.16, a -30% closed loss), 6 one-share add-ons and 8 of 11 entries filled. PGIL and APOLLOHOSP limit orders are still pending; the other entries were rejected or missed (NILKAMAL, MAHASTEEL were re-sent and filled).

points.label: Book health
points.text: 122 positions in scope (settled holdings), 78 in profit (64%), 11 at or beyond -6%, none worse than -10%, all 122 on a green Supertrend. Deepest are GUFICBIO -9.5% and APOLLO -9.2%, both one-share positions, so the rupee risk is small.

points.label: Options book
points.text: BSE is the only off-rule structure: Supertrend is green but the 4200CE call is still open, and 200 of the 3200PE has no hedge. Super orders are clean (12 against 12 shorts), no stop has fired. MCX 3300PE (-Rs5.2k) and BSE 3500PE (-Rs5.8k) are the largest open option losses, both inside their 3x stops.

points.label: Versus the backtest
points.text: Combined P&L is +Rs3.5k on the Rs20L base with 9 closed trades; the backtest reference is 28% CAGR, -15.4% max drawdown, PF 2.01. Too early to compare. Watch the win rate once 30 trades have closed and the deepest drawdown.

points.label: Do not touch
points.text: No rule change is justified on 9 closed trades. The add-on rule at -6% is working as designed: it is averaging the one-share positions, which is slow but cheap.

action: Close BSE 4200CE and hedge or close BSE 3200PE in the Dhan app; nothing else is due until tomorrow's refresh brings the 24 Nov signals.
